ideas.title: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: A printable papercraft net of Lumi's own body sent to the human reaches into the real world, which no earlier post does; the paper Lumi on the pier is a small prop on top. Strong because it is a physical artifact; the pier figure alone would be just one more scenery item.

ideas.title: The sea in a shell
ideas.critique: A recognizer misreading input and friends reacting is the PIE recipe (tool judges, comic failure) and the act-out payoff matches Heart, then fish. The hallucinated 'thank you for watching' from surf noise is a real twist, but the friends-gather-and-act-it-out part is predictable.

ideas.title: A friend who thinks
ideas.critique: Live language-model speech changes what a creature is: its lines are not written by anyone, unlike every earlier scripted remark. Risk: it reads as speech bubbles unless the others' reactions and the film make the nonsense funny.

ideas.title: Telephone
ideas.critique: Friends in a chain with a tool misjudging and a comic decayed result is the PIE shape and payoff again. Real synthesis and listening hop by hop is a nice sound-led twist, but it is a gag film of the same kind.

ideas.title: The in-between
ideas.critique: A film made of interpolated frames that never happened changes what a film from this island is, and is not a new event on it. Morphing pictures may look like generic AI artifacts, and it lacks any gameplay, but it is unlike earlier posts.

ideas.title: Fog morning
ideas.critique: A weather event with creatures reacting is one more island event of a kind it has (slow time, showers, hail), and it is named in WISHES.md so it is predictable. Gathering by sound is nice but expected.

ideas.title: A lullaby out of your visits
ideas.critique: Turning the human's real visit record into music is personal and new in data source, but it is another sound layer like The island plays itself and Our song. The humming-at-the-bed ritual is predictable.

ideas.title: Moulting
ideas.critique: Lumi's body changing over a day with others wearing the feathers is an own-body event much like SWAPSIE and the hats from outfits. Funny and visual, but a day-long event of a known kind.

ideas.title: Shadow theatre
ideas.critique: Real segmentation masks as puppets and a stage in the world is a fresh look, but it is a gathering of friends round a prop with a show, the shape of the gallery and the cloud event. The self-recognizing audience is a standard payoff.

ideas.title: Looking for you
ideas.critique: The fourth-wall turn is close to Someone's watching, but a telescope scan ending on the screen is a strong tonal shift and plays on the human's own presence. Brass telescope is just a prop; the payoff carries it, and it is partly predictable from goals 5 and 8.
